events.summary: 塔拉辛午夜后离开新居，不许守卫跟随，独自在宫殿走廊游荡并登上屋顶塔基
events.quote: She left her new quarters, expressly forbidding the guards stationed outside from following her. They balked at that but she was firm in wanting to be alone.

events.summary: 塔拉辛要出征，命巴昆不要随行、回阿卡塔马索克去，心里明白这是个大错
events.quote: “I’m off to war soon,” Talasyn said. “Don’t come with me. You should return to Aktamasok.”

events.summary: 塔拉辛再无动作前跪低，额头抵住世界吞噬者闭着的唇，说自己是她的后代却不是她
events.quote: Standing there atop the gilded Roof of Heaven, beneath the seven moons, she bowed, resting her forehead against the World-Eater’s closed lips.

events.summary: 巴昆展翅飞走，方向却不是阿卡塔马索克；天亮后派出的人回报各族巡逻队都没见它回巢
events.quote: Talasyn watched it fly off, and soon her lips tilted in a confused frown as she realized that the dragon was heading in the opposite direction of Aktamasok.

events.summary: 塔拉辛恢复二十一年前被免职的拉帕特上尉军职，任命其为将军
events.quote: But the civil war has long been over and it is high time for us to lay its ghosts to rest. Today I am reinstating you.”

events.summary: 埃克利回报迪仓逃到利达加特岛高脚村后落湖溺死、已验尸，塔拉辛命宫里供养其家人
events.quote: When I arrived there, however, they said he had fallen into the lake and drowned. I had the body exhumed and it did look to be him, Your Majesty.”

events.summary: 塔拉辛撤销王室对尼安哈与拉詹·埃斯蒂马婚约的认可，命她即刻退婚
events.quote: “I am rescinding the royal house’s approval of this betrothal. Break it off.

events.summary: 首次大议事会上群臣吵成一团，塔拉辛宣称与凯萨斯的同盟早已破裂，逼众人表态
events.quote: “If we do nothing,” Talasyn concluded, “then we don’t get to complain about the outcome. So now we must choose.”

relations.relation: 龙与其人类羁绊的继承者（非原主，仅是其回响）
relations.quote: “I’m the first aethermancer to be her descendant and that’s why you and I can see each other’s hearts. But I’ll never be her.”

relations.relation: 君臣：新女王免其旧罪、擢升将军，拉帕特宣誓效忠
relations.quote: He saluted fervently, clicking his heels together, his head held high. “I shall serve you well, Your Majesty,” he vowed, choked with emotion.

relations.relation: 君臣：塔拉辛将其从队长擢升为皇家卫队统领，埃克利向她复命
relations.quote: Ekli, who had risen overnight from kaptan of Her Grace’s surviving Lachis-dalo to the commander of Her Majesty’s royal guard

relations.relation: 亲密/疑似恋人（她退婚后他追出走廊）
relations.quote: It sounded as though he was unceremoniously cut off by something pressing over his lips, and mercifully the door closed before Talasyn could hear the rest of it.

relations.relation: 政治婚约（由亡母在乌尔都贾建议下安排，被塔拉辛撤销）
relations.quote: “Quite so, Harlikaan,” Niamha replied brightly. “It was arranged by my late mother at Queen Urduja’s suggestion.

numbers.context: 拉帕特被乌尔都贾剥夺军衔距今的时间
numbers.quote: “Kaptan Rapat,” Talasyn said, “twenty years ago—almost twenty-one, now—my grandmother stripped you of your rank for failing to stop Sintan Silim’s forces from breaching the Dominion capital.

numbers.context: 巴昆每千年只苏醒一次且为时极短
numbers.quote: But Bakun was supposed to wake only once and only briefly every thousand years. Talasyn had disrupted its life cycle out of sheer desperation.

numbers.context: 照亮塔拉辛穿行宫殿走廊的月亮数量
numbers.quote: The seven moons lit her path as she wandered the royal palace’s marble hallways, her heavy steps eventually taking her up one staircase after another

numbers.context: 全体国民躲进 dominion 境内躲避夜帝国的时长
numbers.quote: The Sardovians spent nearly a year hiding from the Night Empire in Dominion space, while at the same time gathering resources and allies.

numbers.context: 阿伦西娜·伊夫拉利斯治下的首次大议事会
numbers.quote: the heads of every noble house scattered throughout the Dominion archipelago descended upon the Roof of Heaven for the first grand assembly of Alunsina Ivralis’s reign

numbers.context: 塔拉辛的婚姻终结的 Nenavar 孤立主义持续时长
numbers.quote: My marriage brought an end to thousands of years of Nenavarene isolationism.

notes: 原文开头有重复标题：第1行与第12行各出现一次 “Chapter Forty-Three”，中间夹约10个空行，属提取件残留。个别引语跨句成段（如第171段把 “My marriage… contend with it.” 整段包在引号内、说话人归属落在段中），不影响逐字取片。第87段 “Lachis-dalo” 用连字符，与全书他处 “Lachis’ka” 的写法不一致，疑为原文/排版差异，照录。第120段 “I don’t like him” 后紧跟无引号叙述再起引号，引号配对略乱，照录。
